fields.name: Mapper mapped query-contract materialization
fields.contract: Mapper is a static library surface that translates declared model mapping metadata at a query contract boundary. Its extension families (1) append mapped input or output parameters while allowing already-present and explicitly ignored names to remain excluded, (2) materialize a new or supplied model from output parameters or one reader row, and (3) materialize a list from reader rows. Each materialization family has a variant accepting a Shard identifier; query-result handler variants accept a root model plus zero through eight typed dependent reader-result collections, with optional output-parameter materialization. Because each extension family is implemented as a C# extension method whose `this` parameter is a DbParameterCollection or DbDataReader, a caller may invoke them with extension-method syntax as `parameters.CreateInputParameters(...)` or `rdr.ToModel(...)`; ordinary static invocation as `Mapper.CreateInputParameters(...)` remains legal C# and is not disabled by declaring the method as an extension. Mapper also holds several per-model-Type delegate caches as private static fields; they are internal compiled-delegate state, not public surface.
